depth_evidence: algorithmic depth proxy such as QAOA p or encoding depth formula
gate_count_evidence: not required unless formulation reports gates
interpretation_limit: Defines what could be measured; does not demonstrate executable or useful routing performance.

depth_evidence: reported p, layer count, theoretical depth, or ansatz setting
shots_evidence: optional; only if simulation reports shots
feasibility_evidence: feasible/optimal probability or validity if reported
interpretation_limit: p/L/theoretical depth are not physical transpiled depth.

depth_evidence: QAOA p plus transpiled/decomposed depth or gate counts when available
feasibility_evidence: infeasible top states or feasible solution rate if reported
interpretation_limit: Hardware workflow evidence is stronger than simulation, but small NISQ evidence is not operational utility.

depth_evidence: theoretical depth or quantum volume estimates
shots_evidence: may be part of runtime assumptions
resource_estimate_evidence: logical/physical qubits, depth, volume, architecture assumptions
interpretation_limit: Resource estimates depend on model and architecture assumptions; they do not prove near-term feasibility.

width_evidence: fault-tolerant logical/physical resource scenario if available
depth_evidence: fault-tolerant circuit depth/gate budget if available
runtime_evidence: end-to-end runtime and utility comparison needed
feasibility_evidence: application-level feasible solution and quality evidence needed
resource_estimate_evidence: full-stack resource and utility evidence needed
interpretation_limit: This is a scenario/target level unless application-specific primary evidence and classical baselines are available.
